My Ref. No.: 4-3/4/2017/D/550. Divisional Secretary's Ref. No.: DS/RAT/LND/04/21/02. BY virtue of the powers vested in me by the order under section 38(a) of Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, do hereby direct the Acquiring Oﬃ cer or any other oﬃ cer authorized by him referred to in Paragraph 1 of the Schedule to take possession of the land speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in Paragraph 2 of that Schedule.

Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, No. 1200/06,Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.
